name: piBrick PocketCM5
summary: A compact Raspberry Pi CM5 handheld with AMOLED display, physical QWERTY keyboard, NVMe storage and a maker-friendly expansion design.
specs: On-cell capacitive multitouch, up to 5 points
Physical QWERTY BBQ20 keyboard with integrated trackpad
5000 mAh LiPo recommended; battery not included
USB 3 Type-C, USB 3 Type-A, USB 2 Type-A, external USB-C
3.5 mm audio, stereo speakers, USB audio
GPIO / I²C, camera connector, auxiliary RP2040 controller

faq.question: What is included in the piBrick package?
faq.answer: The package includes the piBrick PocketCM5 hardware components. Raspberry Pi CM5, battery, and NVMe SSD are not included.

faq.question: Which Raspberry Pi Compute Module is supported?
faq.answer: piBrick PocketCM5 is designed for Raspberry Pi Compute Module 5.

faq.question: Can I install an NVMe SSD?
faq.answer: Yes. The mainboard supports M.2 NVMe SSDs in 2230 and 2242 sizes.

faq.question: Does it include a battery?
faq.answer: No. The battery is not included. A 5000 mAh LiPo battery is recommended.

faq.question: Can I install my own operating system?
faq.answer: Yes. piBrick is based on Raspberry Pi CM5 and supports compatible Raspberry Pi operating systems.
